title: Replacement Effects: Rest in Peace, Doubling Season, and Rule 616.1 Ordering

cited_rules.summary: A planeswalker enters with loyalty counters equal to its printed loyalty via a replacement effect.
Effects reading 'enters with ...' are replacement effects that modify how a permanent enters the battlefield.
A replacement effect cannot apply more than once to the same event or its modified result.
If an event is replaced, the original event never happens and abilities that trigger on the original event do not trigger.
When multiple replacement effects apply to the same event, the affected player or controller of the affected object chooses which applies first.
Dies means being put into a graveyard from the battlefield.

provenance.source_summary: Core replacement-effect stress benchmark covering suppressed death triggers, counter doubling vs loyalty costs, and affected-player ordering under Rule 616.1.
provenance.scope_notes: Preemptive benchmark authored before full replacement-effect choice architecture completes.

rest_in_peace.name: Rest in Peace
rest_in_peace.oracle_text:
When Rest in Peace enters, exile all graveyards.
If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

blood_artist.name: Blood Artist
blood_artist.oracle_text: Whenever Blood Artist or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

shock.name: Shock
shock.oracle_text: Shock deals 2 damage to any target.

doubling_season.name: Doubling Season
doubling_season.oracle_text:
If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead.
If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.

jace_tms.name: Jace, the Mind Sculptor
jace_tms.oracle_text:
+2: Look at the top card of target player's library. You may put that card on the bottom of that player's library.
0: Draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.
-1: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
-12: Exile all cards from target player's library, then that player shuffles their hand into their library.

torbran.name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
torbran.oracle_text: If a red source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.

furnace_of_rath.name: Furnace of Rath
furnace_of_rath.oracle_text: If a source would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage to that permanent or player instead.

cases.name: Rest in Peace replaces dying with exile and suppresses Blood Artist
cases.summary: Shock deals lethal damage to Grizzly Bears while Rest in Peace is on the battlefield; Grizzly Bears goes straight to exile and Blood Artist never triggers.

action.description: P1 casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears.
Shock resolves and state-based actions destroy Grizzly Bears.

invariants.description: Because Rest in Peace replaces going to the graveyard with exile, the creature never dies and dies triggers never fire.

cases.name: Doubling Season doubles planeswalker ETB loyalty but not +2 activation cost
cases.summary: Jace enters with 6 loyalty counters (3 doubled to 6 via Rule 306.5b + 614.1c), then activating +2 adds only 2 counters to reach 8 because paying a loyalty cost is not an effect.

action.description: P1 casts Jace, the Mind Sculptor while controlling Doubling Season.
Jace enters the battlefield with doubled starting loyalty.
P1 activates Jace's +2 loyalty ability by paying the +2 cost.

invariants.description: Doubling Season doubles counters placed by effects (including intrinsic ETB loyalty) but never doubles counters placed as a cost to activate a loyalty ability.

cases.name: Torbran + Furnace of Rath lets affected opponent minimize damage under Rule 616.1
cases.summary: P1 casts Shock targeting P2 with Torbran and Furnace of Rath out; P2 (the affected player) chooses Furnace first (2*2=4) then Torbran (+2=6) instead of Torbran first ((2+2)*2=8).

action.description: Affected player P2 orders Furnace of Rath before Torbran to take 6 damage instead of 8.

invariants.description: The player being dealt damage (not the controller of the damage source or replacement effects) chooses the order of competing damage replacement effects.
